sourceQuote: Yet she chose to walk home with Sam, who was afraid of the dark.
usageNote: of 后接害怕的事物，原句中是 the dark。
collocations: be afraid of heights 怕高
contrast: be afraid of 说明害怕的对象；be worried about 侧重对事情的担忧。
memoryExample: My brother is afraid of heights.
